premises.text: Conventional databases only store, organize, and look up data rather than understand or predict from it
premises.evidence_span: storing, organizing, and letting you look things up in your data

premises.text: Veritable is a predictive database that learns relationships in tabular data and fills in missing values
premises.evidence_span: it can predict. missing values based on your data

premises.text: Prediction is exposed through a SQL-like predict interface so existing database users need no specialized math or data science
premises.evidence_span: if you can use SQL, you can use Veritable

premises.text: Predictions return confidence intervals so users know how sure the system is
premises.evidence_span: when Veritable tells you this answer, it gives you back a confidence interval

value.text: Application builders get intelligent predictions from their data without hiring data scientists or doing the math
value.evidence_span: give you the capability of doing these sorts of things without having to understand all the math

causal_links.evidence_span: what if we were to make the actual database itself a lot smarter?
if you can use SQL, you can use Veritable
